title: Global polynomial standardizer and Artinian coefficient solution
statement: Let k be a field of characteristic p>0, A and Λ commutative k-algebras, A finitely presented over k and Λ Noetherian. For an algebra map h define H(h) to be the radical of the extended singular ideal. Let α:A→Λ be a k-algebra map and q a prime of Λ. A polynomial-base datum consists of an integer m, R=k[X_1,…,X_m], compatible k-algebra structures R→Λ and R→C on a commutative ring C finitely presented over R, and maps β:A→C over k and γ:C→Λ over R, such that γβ=α and H(α)⊆H(γ). A parameter datum consists of an integer r≥1 and π_0,…,π_(r-1) in R. Each π_i maps into q. For each i let B_i be R/(π_j^8:j<i) and T_i be Λ/(image(π_j)^8:j<i). Multiplication by π_i and by π_i² have identical kernels on both B_i and T_i. Each image of π_i in C is strictly standard over R. Define J=(π_i^8) in R, J_C=JC, J_Λ=JΛ, Q=R_(q∩R), L=Λ_q, JQ=J·Q and JL=J·L. Use the induced algebra map Q→L. Assume Λ is geometrically regular over k. Supply an integer N>0 and the containment m_L^N⊆HΛ_q, where H is the extension of the singular ideal of A over k. No minimality assumption on q is imposed. Then polynomial-base and parameter data as above exist, together with n>0, an ideal I₀ of R and an ideal K of L, such that m_L^n⊆JL, I₀Q⊆JQ, K⊆JL and I₀L⊆K. There are an integer t≥0 and a local Artinian commutative ring D′, whose carrier lies in Type(max(u,v)). Set E=D′[T_1,…,T_t]. There are compatible R- and R/I₀-algebra structures on this actual polynomial ring E, an essentially smooth structure over R/I₀, and R-algebra maps a:C→E and b:E→L/K with ba equal to C→Λ→L→L/K. Local means that D′ has a unique maximal ideal; Artinian means descending chains of ideals stabilize. C is also represented in Type(max(u,v)). The statement does not yet construct the localized factorization of Q⊗_R C. All rings, ideals, quotient algebras and maps are in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]; the polynomial construction is [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring].

proof.text: Set L=Λ_q and d=spanFinrank(m_L). Apply the universal-standardizer lemma at d,N to obtain generators a_j, the explicitly presented B, improved C₀, β₀, retraction ρ, positive c, and the universal base-change conclusions.

Apply the compatible-parameter-solution lemma to this B and its actual presentation P, with c. Obtain R,η,π, n,I₀,K and the polynomial Artinian solution E with θ:B→E and b:E→L/K. Its hypotheses on generators and relations come from the first lemma, not from any assumed presentation of C₀.

Construct C=R⊗_S C₀, β=(C₀→C)β₀, and γ the R-algebra tensor lift of ηρ. Finite presentation follows by base change. On x∈A, γβ(x)=ηρβ₀(x)=η(A→B)(x)=α(x), using the two supplied coefficient-map equalities. Specialize the universal base-change conclusion to R,η to obtain the Popescu-ideal inclusion. Each π_i is zero or an image of X_j^c, so its image in C is strictly standard. The nonempty parameter count is r=d+1.

Retain n,I₀,K,t,D′ and the actual polynomial E from the coefficient solution. Construct a:C→E as the tensor lift of θρ. Both b a and the canonical C→Λ→L/K are R-algebra maps. By tensor-map extensionality it suffices to compare them on 1⊗x for x∈C₀. There the identity is bθρ(x)=ηρ(x) modulo K, exactly the supplied identity on B evaluated at ρ(x). This proves the required quotient factorization.

theorem exists_popescu_char_p_preparation_global
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k Λ]
    [FinitePresentation k A] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (α : A →ₐ[k] Λ) (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (hreg : IsGeometricallyRegular k Λ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hpower : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ N ≤
      (Ideal.map α.toRingHom (singularIdeal k A)).map
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (_ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (C : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra k C)
      (_ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C)
      (_ : FinitePresentation (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C)
      (β : A →ₐ[k] C) (γ : C →ₐ[MvPolynomial (Fin m) k] Λ),
      (γ.restrictScalars k).comp β = α ∧ popescuIdeal α ≤ popescuIdeal γ ∧
      ∃ (r : ℕ) (π : Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin m) k),
        1 ≤ r ∧
        (∀ i, algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (π i) ∈ q.asIdeal) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin r)
          (x : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ Ideal.span
            {y | ∃ j : Fin r, j.val < i.val ∧ y = π j ^ 8}),
          π i • x = 0 ↔ π i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin r)
          (x : Λ ⧸ Ideal.span
            {y | ∃ j : Fin r, j.val < i.val ∧
              y = algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (π j) ^ 8}),
          π i • x = 0 ↔ π i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
        (∀ i, IsStrictlyStandardElement
          (R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C (π i))) ∧
    let R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k
    let J := Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin r ↦ π i ^ 8))
    let Q := Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.under R)
    let L := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
    letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver (q.asIdeal.under R) q.asIdeal
    let JQ := J.map (algebraMap R Q)
    let JL := (J.map (algebraMap R Λ)).map (algebraMap Λ L)
    ∃ (n : ℕ), 0 < n ∧ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L ^ n ≤ JL ∧
      ∃ (I₀ : Ideal R) (K : Ideal L),
        I₀.map (algebraMap R Q) ≤ JQ ∧ K ≤ JL ∧
        (I₀.map (algebraMap R Q)).map (algebraMap Q L) ≤ K ∧
        ∃ (t : ℕ) (D' : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing D')
          (_ : IsLocalRing D') (_ : IsArtinianRing D'),
          let E := MvPolynomial (Fin t) D'
          ∃ (_ : Algebra R E) (_ : Algebra (R ⧸ I₀) E)
            (_ : IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ I₀) E),
            EssentiallySmooth (R ⧸ I₀) E ∧
            ∃ (a : C →ₐ[R] E) (b : E →ₐ[R] L ⧸ K),
              b.comp a = (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R K).comp
                ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R Λ L).comp γ)
